settings.breed_blurb: Compact, comical and irresistibly charming — Pugs are natural entertainers who steal every spotlight in their tiny outfits.
settings.tip_lehenga: Choose lehengas with wide, flexible neck openings — Pugs have short necks and flat faces so airflow is essential.
settings.tip_sherwani: Short-length sherwanis with a V-neck or open collar look adorable and keep Pugs comfortable. Avoid tight collars.
settings.tip_tshirt: Loose, breathable tees are a must for Pugs who overheat easily. Choose lightweight fabric in cooler colours.
settings.tip_colours: Bright pinks, yellows and turquoise pop beautifully against a Pug's fawn or black coat and make for the cutest photos.
